hook.name: NasdankFeeHookPairUniversal
hook.description: A fee hook that charges a configurable pip fee on the pair-token leg of every swap, accruing fees as ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager. Fees are split between a project treasury (paid in the pair token) and a protocol treasury (converted to WETH via a frozen V3 route, with a two-hop VIA_USDG fallback on degradation).
